dataset_description: Monthly sales transactions for an e-commerce platform across APAC region in FY 2024.
business_context: The company sells consumer electronics online. This dataset tracks order-level data including product, customer segment, geography, and financials.

revenue.description: Total revenue generated by the order (before deductions)

profit.description: Net profit after cost of goods and shipping

quantity.description: Number of units sold in the order

customer_segment.description: Customer type: Consumer, Corporate, or Home Office

discount.description: Discount rate applied to the order

returned.description: Whether the order was returned (Yes / No)

sheets.Returns: Orders that were returned, with return reason
